stories.headline: OpenAI's Astra triggers stronger safety controls
stories.summary: OpenAI says its upcoming Astra model can find and exploit previously unknown cybersecurity flaws with little human guidance. It will initially have limited access and is the first model to trigger tougher controls under OpenAI's safety protocol.

stories.headline: Tesla prepares to show production Cybercab
stories.summary: Tesla plans to present its purpose-built autonomous Cybercab in Austin today. The company has not disclosed the event time or confirmed commercial approval; safety investigations and regulatory requirements remain significant uncertainties.

stories.headline: Stopgap bill averts US government shutdown
stories.summary: President Trump signed legislation extending federal funding through December 11. It avoids an October shutdown but leaves all 12 full-year spending bills unfinished and postpones the underlying budget dispute until after the midterms.

stories.headline: Iran war escalation raises civilian toll concern
stories.summary: Iran says 18 people died in the latest U.S. strikes, including four at a wedding. The U.S. says it does not target civilians. Reuters verified the reported wedding-site location but not responsibility for the damage.

stories.headline: Russian attack wounds 17 in Odesa
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials said Russian air attacks wounded 17 people, including three children, and damaged a 21-storey residential building in Odesa. Reuters also reported an explosion in Kyiv amid continuing strikes.
